S8.description: Long-format copy of mmc2.xlsx sheet 'Table S8' (Characteristics of lipid-lowering genetic variants in target genes), made from text/mmc2__Table_S8.csv. The sheet has three side-by-side blocks with repeated headers (LDL-C cols A-L, HDL-C cols N-Y, TG cols AA-AL) and merged lipid/Drug Target cells, so the converted CSV cannot be read by header name. Cell strings were copied programmatically (not retyped) and only the merged lipid/Drug Target labels were filled down within each block; source_line is the line in text/mmc2__Table_S8.csv. Exposure effects only (no outcome columns).

Zhou2024lipid-1.notes: All 33 PCSK9 LDL-C variants listed in Table S8. The stage 1-2 IVW (Table S13, r2<0.3: 27 SNPs, OR 1.402) used 27 of them; the same 27 appear for every endometriosis outcome, so the 6 dropped were removed by LD pruning (r2<0.3) or outcome availability, but they are not identified in the supplement, so the full listed set is extracted. No outcome effects, so no recompute.

Zhou2024lipid-2.notes: All 31 APOB LDL-C variants listed in Table S8. The stage 1-2 IVW (Table S13, r2<0.3: 26 SNPs, OR 1.497) used 26 of them (same count for every outcome); the 5 dropped are not identified in the supplement. No outcome effects, so no recompute.

Zhou2024lipid-3.notes: All 21 ANGPTL3 TG variants listed in Table S8 (right block). The stage 1-2 IVW (Table S13, r2<0.3: 18 SNPs, OR 1.568) used 18 (same count for every outcome); the 3 dropped are not identified in the supplement. No outcome effects, so no recompute.
